## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Reviewed-by: `session_01ADHkmQxwoGb5fSnrFkpxmt`
Implemented-by: `session_01ADHkmRczGnhouFCUs9DfQ2`
Head-sha: `867f477774a5239467d5213259c234fc9fea391e`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/runtime/src/meta-write-org-scope.test.ts (the module-top import, the ⭐ D6 case now at L433), packages/runtime/vitest.config.ts (the `^@objectstack/lint$` alias) + packages/metadata-protocol/src/metadata-diagnostics.ts (`loadFormLayoutLint`, `withFormLayoutWarnings`), packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts (`getMetaItem`'s `serveFormLayout` and its three served exits, read only), packages/lint/package.json (`exports`, dependencies), packages/lint/src/index.ts (the alias target, its import surface), packages/runtime/package.json (`files`), scripts/check-test-source-alias.mjs (the runtime and metadata-protocol ledger rows, the boundary-crossing rule, the clocked-window rule), the Test Core (3/8) log of run 41514567522 (job 125515971369), the card body of #29603, the claim 6588496082, the dev report 6589946407, and the seat delta for #29603.

Face: none of the four (no `packages/spec/src/**` path, no governed path, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial on the PR body; `check-governed-merges --pr 29622` answers 0 of 2 paths hit, 13 surfaces governing). Merge-base `81cd9eb0e9f2fb32a9ae01ef60dc4da45f892ef2`; net diff 2 files, 19 insertions, 0 deletions. The PR file list equals the dev report's `files_changed`: the claim's declared surface (the test file) plus the one deviation the report declares (the vitest config). Nothing under `packages/metadata-protocol/**` (protocol.ts is frozen for #25467 E2 and is untouched), `packages/spec/**` or `ui/**` moves. `main` has moved 12 commits since the merge-base; none touches the two diff files, metadata-diagnostics.ts, `packages/lint/src`, lint's package.json or the alias gate. The one same-package commit on protocol.ts (#29456, `7b293c40c7`) is a connector save-path change, not the view read. No re-merge is owed (discipline §10). PR author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, branch `claude/project-thread-2g17eb`, the one the claim names; no relay author to name. The PR carries no review and no competing `Contract-review-claim:`; the card carries the claim and the dev report only.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **The failure was a timeout, not an assertion, and the card's diagnosis is right.** The job log of run 41514567522 (Test Core 3/8, head `1a95c746`) reads `Error: Test timed out in 5000ms.` at `src/meta-write-org-scope.test.ts:419:5`, the ⭐ case at 5210 ms, the file at 5978 ms, 20 tests, 1 failed. The case is a `PUT /view/overdue_grid` then a `GET` of the same name through the real `HttpDispatcher` → `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.getMetaItem`. On the served face, `getMetaItem` wraps every served exit in `serveFormLayout` (protocol.ts L11465-11467, exits at L11475, L11766 and L12045), which calls `withFormLayoutWarnings(request.type, served, getObject)`; for a `view` that resolved to a record that function `await`s `loadFormLayoutLint()` BEFORE it resolves any object name, and `loadFormLayoutLint` is `formLayoutLint ??= import('@objectstack/lint')` (metadata-diagnostics.ts L469-475), a lazy import of the lint package ROOT. In the runtime suite `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` resolves to `dist/` (it is in runtime's `KNOWN_UNALIASED_TEST_IMPORTS` row), and a pnpm-linked `dist/` is inlined and transformed by Vite (the gate's own header, the #11412 note), so that `import()` is a cold Vite transform of the lint graph on the first served view read of the process, inside whichever case makes it. The sibling plural-spelling case does the same `PUT` with no `GET`, which is why it runs in single-digit milliseconds. **Right**; the cost is where the dev says it is, and it is not a boot, a poll or a driver path.
2. **The warm-up keeps the case's proof intact.** The diff adds 14 lines above the imports and nothing else in the file: no `it`, `expect`, `timeout` or helper moves (the only effect on the case is its line number, 419 → 433). The case still writes through the real dispatcher, asserts `200`, asserts `'organization_id' in row` is `false` on the stored row the real `SysMetadataRepository` wrote (the env-wide pin), reads the same name back through the same dispatcher and asserts `200` (the read serves it). The read path is unchanged: `serveFormLayout` still runs, `loadFormLayoutLint` still fires its `import()`, the lint rule still judges the served body; what the module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'` changes is only WHEN Vite transforms that graph (during collection, which `testTimeout` does not clock), since the protocol's later `import()` is served from the same module graph. The dev's measurement (first GET 1500 ms → 7 ms, second GET 2 ms both before and after) is the reading that the same instance comes back; I did not re-run it. The delta's three prohibitions hold: no timeout raised, no retry/skip/quarantine, no assertion weakened. **Right**.
3. **The alias is anchored, correct, and forced.** `{ find: /^@objectstack\/lint$/, replacement: path.resolve(__dirname, '../lint/src/index.ts') }`; the target exists at this head; the entry sits beside the pre-existing anchored `/runtime` entry, and lint's third published subpath (`/rule-explanations`) is imported by no file under `packages/runtime` (src or tests), and would in any case fall through to `exports`, not through a file: no rule-5 (ENOTDIR) shape. It is forced: `@objectstack/lint` is absent from runtime's shrink-only ledger row (no runtime test imported the root before), so a module-top value import of a specifier resolving to `dist/` reds `check:test-source-alias` with the alias as its printed remedy; the dev measured exactly that on the first head `da6bf162`, green on this head, and `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (which carries the gate) is `success` on `867f4777`. **Right**.
4. **What the alias changes for other tests, honestly stated.** Every runtime test (both vitest projects, `extends: true`) whose first served view read reaches `loadFormLayoutLint` now gets lint's SOURCE graph instead of `dist/index.js`; no runtime source file imports the lint root (only `/runtime`, in `domains/new-similar-target.ts`), so that lazy import is the only other reader. The dev declares this in deviation 1 and ran the runtime suite on it: 528/528 files, 8506 passed, 19 skipped. The gate's boundary crossing now walks lint's source against runtime's alias table for rule 5 only: lint imports `@objectstack/spec/NAMESPACE` (runtime's anchored namespace rule covers it), `@objectstack/formula` (anchored entry), `@objectstack/sdui-parser` (no alias, resolves to `dist/` through `exports`, not reported by design), and only type-imports of `typescript`, `sucrase` and `ajv` at module scope. This is the direction the gate exists to push (source over `dist/`), and it is the same shape the #29595 record accepted for the CLI. **Right**, within the declared deviation.
5. **Files outside the declared surface.** One: `packages/runtime/vitest.config.ts`, declared as deviation 1 with the forcing gate named. Nothing else. The frozen `protocol.ts` is read, not touched. **Right**.
6. **No product cost masked that a user would feel, on this evidence.** In production the same lazy import is a one-time Node load of lint's BUILT root entry per process on the first served view read; the 1.2 s is the Vite transform under vitest, not that load. I did not measure the built load (no lint `dist/` in this checkout; `Local-runs: none`). The lazy shape is a documented design choice in the source (metadata-diagnostics.ts: the kernel boot path reaches `@objectstack/lint` only through `/runtime`, loaded "as `build-probes.ts` loads its lint rule"), the test never asserted on the warnings it adds (the dedicated pin is metadata-protocol's `protocol.form-layout-diagnostics.test.ts`, which already preloads the root), and the delta's product-code clause covers "a needless wait", which a one-time module load by design is not. Nothing to file under Prime Directive #10 (no defect, no contract violation, no measured latency). If the seat wants the number, it is one measurement on a built server (time the first `GET /view` of a process) before any card; `carrier: none · noted, not filed`.
7. **Trailers and body declarations.** Both authored commits end with `Claude-Session:` and the model-free `Co-authored-by: Claude` pair; the PR body carries `Fixes #29603`, line-initial `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` (matching the claim), the six-line 维护者速读, a `## Verification` naming the head, and "Forced test edits: none" (true: the diff forces none). **Right**.

### ② Semver level

- No changeset; label `skip-changeset`; `Check Changeset` is `success` on this head. `@objectstack/runtime` publishes `files: ["dist", "README.md", "CHANGELOG.md"]`, so neither `src/meta-write-org-scope.test.ts` nor `vitest.config.ts` ships in any tarball, and no other package moves. AGENTS.md's rule ("that label is for a diff that publishes nothing from any released package") is met exactly, and the delta expected it ("Use `skip-changeset` … if only tests change"). **Right**.
- Declarations `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` are the measured values for a diff that changes no accept set and no authorable surface. **Right**.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev `open_questions`, one: the same cold load may sit inside clocked cases of other runtime test files; A leave it (dev's recommendation) or B file a devx card to measure the population and preload at module top where it lands in a clocked case.** My view: **A for this PR, and B as a card the seat files now, p3 devx, rather than waiting for a second red.** Reasons. (1) The cost is measured, not hypothetical: 1202 ms p50 / 1740 ms max idle, 1463 / 1654 ms under four concurrent copies, against a 5000 ms budget, in whichever case makes a file's first served view read; the red run paid 5210 ms, so the margin a loaded shard needs is the one this card just spent a triage round on. (2) The gate's own header says it cannot follow a load inside another package's code and that "widening the population is a different card": the repo already names B as the right carrier. (3) The runtime population is small and enumerable from this head. A coarse grep over test files that construct the real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` and read a `view` by name, minus files that import the lint root at module top, names in runtime: `src/package-revert-stored-members.integration.test.ts` (`servedLabel` → `protocol.getMetaItem({ type: 'view', … })` on a published view, first reached at the end of case (a), default budget, after a per-case kernel boot) and `src/domains/meta-save-preconditions-parity.test.ts` (`door.read` through the real REST route and catch-all in the #24395 cases at the default budget; the #22141 cases carry 60 s). `src/domains/packages-seed-apply-org-scope.test.ts` reads `view` / `anything`, a miss; I did not trace whether the miss exit precedes the decoration, so it is at most a candidate. Outside runtime the same grep names 13 metadata-protocol test files and 6 objectql test files, where the lint root is `dist/` too; the grep does not tell whether each read resolves or sits in a clocked window, so those counts are a starting list for the card, not findings. (4) Nothing of this belongs in this PR: the delta's surface is one file, and a sweep is the shape the gate's header and the seat's standing order both refuse. The out-of-scope line in the dev report (`carrier: none · noted, not filed`) is answered by this: file it.
- **Deviation 1 (`vitest.config.ts`)**: accepted, ①.3-①.4. **Deviation 2** (not re-merged after `main` moved): no overlap, nothing owed.
- **Check-runs on head `867f4777` at 2026-11-02T22:31Z: 25 `completed/success`, 18 `completed/skipped`, 8 `in_progress`, 0 failed or cancelled.** Of the ten required contexts, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Test UI` and `Live E2E UI` are `success`; `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI` and `Build & E2E UI` are `skipped` by their `ui/**` path filter, as expected for a diff with no `ui/**` path; `TypeScript Type Check` (`workspace` and `consumer gates` still running; `source gates` and `debt ledger` are `success`) and `Test Core` (shards 1/8 and 6/8 `success`; 2, 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8 still running) are `in_progress`. Every completed run is `success` or `skipped`. `Test Core (3/8)` is the shard that went red on `main` and the one whose completion is the direct reading for this fix; this record judges the tree and the completed conclusions, and the all-green landing precondition is the seat's to read again before queueing. The Docs Drift Check comment on the PR (`vitest.config.ts` yields no doc anchor) is advisory and asks for nothing.
- Governed surface: none; size 19 changed lines; `skip-changeset`, `tests`, `size/s` labels; draft, as the standing order requires until ACCEPT.

### ④ Design judgment

Not owed on this face (no schema, governed or narrowing path). The one design question the card raises, whether the lazy load is product cost to fix at the source, is answered in ①.6: the lazy root import is the declared design, the delta's product-code clause does not reach it, and no measured user-side latency is on record.

**VERDICT: PASS**

Must-fix: none.
Should-fix (no landing blocker):
1. For the seat's ACCEPT, not the dev: read the check-runs again once `Test Core` (shard 3/8 in particular) and `TypeScript Type Check` complete; and take the file's wall time for `meta-write-org-scope.test.ts` from that shard's log on this head as the after-reading on the suite-weight axis (the PR's table reports the file as the sum of case durations, 218 / 268 ms, which is the right measure for the clocked window and not the wall the 10 s rule is stated in; the red run's wall was 5978 ms with the load inside, and the move can only lower it).
2. Open question: file B as a p3 devx card seeded with the population in ③ (two runtime files, the coarse metadata-protocol and objectql lists), the gate's "widening the population is a different card" sentence as its reference, and the one-line-per-file preload as its expected fix; nothing in this PR changes.
